variants.specifics: Brackenford: a miller's man points at Wenna's seal, a fishwife grumbles about the inn's eels, a carter points at Red Corwin on the north road.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Wenna's been weeping all week. Something about Urchins and her mill.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Don't eat the eels at the Drowned Lantern. Just don't.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Nobody takes the north road now. Not with Red Corwin's lot sitting up in that old tower!

variants.specifics: Cave town of miners: a miner warns about low ceilings, a woman points at the bats in the ninth shaft, a man points at his cousin lost after a cave-in.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Mind your head, stranger. Everybody new does it once. Ha!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Foreman Gast is paying good gold to anyone who'll clear the bats out of the ninth shaft.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: My cousin went down after the cave-in. Not a peep from him since... I fear the worst.

variants.specifics: Swamp hamlet on stilts: a man complains of a loose plank, a woman points at the ferryman's lost girl, a man points at Hagen's bounty on a giant leech.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Watch the third plank from the end. It's been loose since my grandfather's day, and nobody's fixed it yet.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: The ferryman's girl never came back from the reed beds. Her poor mother hasn't slept since!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: There's a leech in the south pool longer than my punt! Hagen says he'll pay to see it dead.

variants.specifics: Castle town with a garrison: a man grumbles about drums at dawn, a woman points at the escaped prisoners, a man points at Skeletons in the chapel crypt.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Drums at dawn, every blessed day. I haven't had a lie-in since the garrison came.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: The Captain's been shouting for an hour. Somebody let the prisoners out of the dungeon!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Skeletons are walking in the crypt under the chapel. Aldric the Priest wants them put back where they belong.

variants.specifics: Lake village of fishermen: a man points at the boat-tipping beast, a woman points at the lights on Gull Isle, a man brushes the player off about the smell.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: The ferry's not running. Something big has been tipping the boats over, out past the reeds.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Saw lights out on Gull Isle again last night. Ghosts, if you ask me.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: That smell? That's just the village, stranger. You get used to it. Mostly.

variants.specifics: Wizards' college town: a scholar points at trouble in the vaults, a woman jokes about a lost apprentice-toad, a man points at a renegade Master in the west tower.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Archivist Pell is in a dreadful state. Something has got into the vaults, they say.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: An apprentice turned himself into a toad last spring. We still don't know which toad.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: The old tower west of the college is lit again. The Masters won't speak of the renegade who lives there.

variants.specifics: Frozen fort on a mountain pass: a soldier scoffs at the cold, a woman points at the overdue supply sled and the White Wolves, a man points at what the scout saw on the high pass.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Cold? This is a warm day, lad! Wait till the wind turns.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: The supply sled is four days late. The Warden fears the White Wolves got to it.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: A scout came back from the high pass with his hair gone white. He won't say what he saw up there.

variants.specifics: Lava-forge town of smiths: a man points at the Emberdemons by the deep vein, a mother points at her boy lost in the slag tunnels, a man mocks a rival smith.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Guildmaster Torva wants iron from the deep vein, but the Emberdemons won't let a soul near it.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: My boy took a dare and went into the slag tunnels! Please, if you see him, send him home!

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Buy your blade from anyone but Hask. His swords bend if you look at them hard.

variants.specifics: Crossroads inn and its hamlet: a carter points at bandits on the east road, a woman gossips about watered ale, a man points at the howling shrine on the hill.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: Heading east? Don't. Bandits took the last two carts off that road.

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: The innkeeper waters the ale. Everybody knows it. Everybody drinks it anyway.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Something howls in the old shrine on the hill every night. Barnaby says it's the wind. It isn't.

variants.specifics: Farming town troubled by Ogres: a man points at the Mayor's taken daughter, a farm-wife complains about her pig and her husband's boots, a man points at Bram the hunter's way into the Ogre caves.

rumour1.speaker: Townsman
rumour1.text: The Ogres carried off the Mayor's daughter! He's offering half his barns to get her back!

rumour2.speaker: Townswoman
rumour2.text: Ogres again! Last week my pig, this week my husband's boots. I'm not sure which I miss more.

rumour3.speaker: Townsman
rumour3.text: Bram the hunter knows a back way into the Ogre caves. If he's sober, that is.
